name: section_nav
title: Section Nav
summary: Sticky in-page section navbar with progress line.
description: Secondary navbar that sticks under the site header: a row of links to the sections of the page (anchor_index - the section in view is marked, links to sections that are not on the page are hidden) and a scroll_progress line on its bottom edge. Below 1024px the links fold into a dropdown opened by a toggle (menu-sections icon + the name of the section in view).
